name: Super Saiyan God
findings: Basic Attack increase is documented as 40–60%, with 60% tied to timed input; no direct Strike or Ki Blast skill damage increase is documented
Ki auto-recovery +60%; movement speed increase documented around 12.5–13.5% across source text
Timed heavy-attack follow-up can deal 36% more damage when the documented cue is hit; exact combo coverage remains unresolved
Unlock route: Shenron Super Saiyan God wish, max friendship with Goku, Vegeta, Gohan & Videl, Gotenks, and Pan, then Beerus awards the skill
Beerus can award the skill to a non-Saiyan character, but the Awoken is usable only by Saiyan CaCs
Exact frames and patch-independent interpretation beyond documented source values remain unresolved
